accepted.reason: Instrument asymmetry, not a paint change: the live <footer> is an AEM experience-fragment wrapper four levels above the navy .Footer, the build <footer> wraps .Footer directly; both <footer> elements compute rgba(0,0,0,0) and both .Footer boxes paint #001b6e at the same rect (measure.mjs: footer > .Footer 0,5790 1440x414 bg rgb(0,27,110) on build = live). Footer crop-compare and pixel diff are the confirmation. Scope: root footer, kind REGION STYLE only (the finding carries no text to narrow on); recorded for archetype index.

Published-regime pipeline delta, not an icon change: the delivery pipeline serves every authored image from the media bus as media_<hash>.<ext> renditions (source-fidelity-gate.md § The published-origin gate), so the header logo's file name cannot match the source's. Same anchor, same 56px box, same artwork: the 360 pixel round on the published origin is 0.64% (index) with the header band clean. Scope: header root, ICON DIFF on the home link only.

Instrument asymmetry, not a paint change: on the delivery platform the header block always renders inside the pipeline's <header> wrapper, which reserves the fixed topbar's 104px (the source reserves it with a spacer outside its zero-height <header>); the painted topbar is the same fixed white bar at the same rect on both sides. Published-origin pixel rounds are the confirmation (index 0.05%/0.64%, at-de 3.82%/5.08%, Δh 0). Scope: root header, REGION BOX and REGION STYLE only.
